summary: History loading is a computed query keyed on picker kind, not two first-in-win actions. setupPhase is a projection. Range clicks go through selectRangeRev, which no-ops off that screen.

test/helpers/model.ts.rationale: Keeps the history computed subscribed like the sidebar

steps.title: Kind is not the list
steps.rationale: The query key must not include from/to or the fetched commits

steps.title: History is a computed
steps.rationale: Leaving commits/range aborts the log; re-entry starts a new one

steps.title: setupPhase is derived
steps.rationale: The sidebar still reads one tagged union; loading and error come from the query

steps.title: Open is set-kind plus settle
steps.rationale: No first-in-win on the command; abort is not a picker error

steps.title: Range clicks are their own action
steps.rationale: Bounds stay on the picker; a stale command cannot invent a range phase

steps.title: selectCommit only generates
steps.rationale: The commit picker no longer shares an action with range bounds

steps.title: submitRange stays on range
steps.rationale: A stale Use post cannot jump the machine into the picker

steps.title: One palette command, two actions
steps.rationale: The webview still posts selectCommit; the host dispatches by phase
